changsha-marathon|2026-11-15.summary: The 2026 Changsha Marathon and Half Marathon take place on 15 November from Xiangjiang Middle Road beside Du Fu Jiang Ge. The event first gun is 07:00; runners must follow their assigned wave.

Marathon.note: The current 2026 regulations and organiser news confirm 15 November at 07:00. The race uses multiple guns; later wave times remain to be announced. Follow your assigned start zone. General registration closed on 11 August.

be-youth-cx-beernem-october|2026-10-25.summary: Beernem’s youth cyclo-cross takes place at Sportpark Drogenbrood, Wellingstraat 29A. U12 starts at 10:00; the 12-, 13- and 14-year-old classes start separately in the afternoon. Races are timed by duration, not a fixed distance.

Cyclo-cross U12.label: U12 start 10:00 CET (UTC+1)
